models_evaluated: Hypotension Prediction Index (machine learning hemodynamic monitor)

links.outcome: Intraoperative hypotension, cardiac index, stroke volume variation with algorithm-guided response
links.effect: IOH reduced 33.3% (5.2% vs 7.8%, P<0.01); cardiac index >2 up 31.6% (83.7% vs 63.6%); SVV <12 up 37.6% (73.2% vs 53.2%); groups differed in case mix; 10 PRE vs 24 POST patients
links.quote: There was a 33.3% reduction in IOH (5.2% ± 0.1% versus 7.8% ± 0.3%, P < 0.01, a 31.6% increase in cardiac index >2.0 (83.7% + 0.2% versus 63.6% + 0.5%, P < 0.01), and a 37.6% increase in stroke volume variation <12 (73.2% + 0.3% versus 53.2% + 0.5%, P < 0.01).

links.outcome: Intraoperative hypotension, cardiac index, and stroke volume variation after implementing prediction-guided management
links.effect: POST versus PRE: IOH 5.2% ± 0.1% versus 7.8% ± 0.3% (33.3% reduction, P < 0.01); cardiac index >2.0 increased 31.6%; stroke volume variation <12 increased 37.6%. Implementation included team education.
links.quote: There was a 33.3% reduction in IOH (5.2% ± 0.1% versus 7.8% ± 0.3%, P < 0.01, a 31.6% increase in cardiac index >2.0 (83.7% + 0.2% versus 63.6% + 0.5%, P < 0.01), and a 37.6% increase in stroke volume variation <12 (73.2% + 0.3% versus 53.2% + 0.5%, P < 0.01).

unlisted_practices: Conducting a pilot study to evaluate the clinical impact of an AI predictive monitoring system deployed alongside user education and a predefined clinical decision-making algorithm for interventions.
